A: Prose says coverage 'fell to 1 to 2 per month in 2026' while Jan and Apr 2026 were 0 (caption says 0-2)
B: sentiment.csv stores ratios in a 'count' column
C: EU ad tech fine dated 2025-09-12 in CSV; the decision was announced 2025-09-05 (labelled estimate)

raw.verdict: A and B both read the measured corpus correctly: a 103-article volume that peaked in August 2024 and faded, with tone 5.24x more negative than baseline. A edges ahead with richer decomposition (critical share, secondary bumps) and by flagging label anomalies such as Colombia and incidental people. Both are honest that ad tech is effectively unmeasured and that the five months before today are missing. C gives useful case milestones from memory, but nothing about what the news measured; D offers almost nothing.
